items.description: Measurement harness for the converter follow-ups: copy .planning/phases/07.1-matching-tooling/measure_curve.py to the batch's own quick directory with its own curve file and a point number range that does not stop at 7; it must never write .planning/phases/07.1-matching-tooling/07.1-CURVE.md and the closed 07.1 files stay unchanged. Keep its self-check and --plant. The coordinator runs the baseline on the main checkout (it needs orig/ and docker): it must reproduce Point 7's Tier 1 converter-only table, 21 exact and 14 near, with the matched-row control.

Lift signed divide by a power of two in tools/reverseapoc/lift.py: the forms `mov; sar; sub; sar` and `mov; sar; shl; sbb; sar` become x / 2^n, and `cdq; xor eax, edx` is abs and stays out of scope unless it falls out. Test first. Todo: .planning/todos/pending/signed-divide-power-of-two.md (largest refusal: op cdq 124 first refusals, op sbb 134 uses).

Fix E1151 in the lifter: `externs.setdefault` keeps the first call's argument count, so 30 Tier 1 rows fail to compile with "Parameter count does not agree with previous definition". Test first. See .planning/phases/07.1-matching-tooling/07.1-03-SUMMARY.md, section "Seen, not built".

Lift string ops (movsd, repne scasb, rep movsd, movsw: 45 first refusals) and x87 forms (fsqrt, fxch, fldln2, fldz, fld1, fyl2x) in tools/reverseapoc/lift.py. Test first. Same 07.1-03-SUMMARY.md section; the C must be what Watcom 10.6 -4r turns back into those bytes.

Close the Phase 7.1 review leftovers in .planning/todos/pending/slot-model-array-ties.md: search.py WR-02 and lift.py IN-01, IN-02, IN-03, with the detail and suggested fixes in .planning/phases/07.1-matching-tooling/07.1-REVIEW.md. Test first. The watcom-readability skill wording it mentions is out of scope (skills change only through writing-skills).
